newsitem.title: USA: Cal Water to buy power from New Energy Ventures.
newsitem.headline: Cal Water to buy power from New Energy Ventures.

text.p: California Water Service Co, an investor-owned water utility serving 1.5 million people in 56 California communities, said Tuesday it selected New Energy Ventures Inc of Los Angeles as an energy advisor and a future energy provider.
Under legislation passed in 1996 by the California Legislature, electricity customers in California will be able to choose their electricity provider beginning January 1, 1998.
New Energy Ventures, which is privately held, was formed in 1995 by former utility executives.
